product.name: eFactory One
product.tagline: The operating system for academic ghostwriting agencies
product.domain: Academic ghostwriting marketplace (DACH region, Germany-first, English-localized UI)
product.elevator_pitch: eFactory replaces Berat's 100% manual workflow (Google Sheets + Notion + WordPress forms + WhatsApp + Outlook) with a unified SaaS platform that orchestrates the entire order lifecycle — from customer inquiry through ghostwriter assignment, interim and final delivery, QA review, dispute handling, and Friday-batch payment release — while preserving the financial and communication firewall that protects the business model.
product.north_star: Reduce Berat's operational load to zero. Every recurring manual action (sheet edits, copy-paste, deadline tracking, GW emails, payment math) becomes one click in the platform.
product.phase: Requirements Engineering — high-fidelity prototype to validate scope before build
product.legal_entity: Bery Ventures GmbH, c/o WeWork Friesenplatz 4, 50672 Köln

design_principles.look_and_feel: Modern operational SaaS, dense information design, calm neutrals with two accent colors. Inspired by Linear, Pipedrive, and Notion. Information density over whitespace — Berat is a power user.
design_principles.typography: Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for IDs and amounts
design_principles.layout_pattern: Persistent left sidebar (collapsible) + top breadcrumb bar + main content. Detail screens use right-side drawer for related entities.
design_principles.data_density: Tables default to 50 rows/page, sticky header, inline status pills, hover row actions, multi-select with bulk actions.
design_principles.tone_of_microcopy: Direct, operational, German-bilingual where rule names matter (e.g. 'Teillieferung — Interim delivery').

roles.label: Admin (Berat)
roles.description: Owner-operator. Full visibility into every order, payment, GW, and message. Approves GW claims, releases payments every Friday, mediates disputes, and self-assigns orders he wants to write himself.

roles.label: QA Reviewer
roles.description: Dedicated efactory1 quality assurance team. Reviews submitted interim and final work for plagiarism, AI use, formatting, and academic standard before forwarding to customer.

roles.label: Service Worker (Employee)
roles.description: Trusted operator who handles repetitive tasks (offer drafting, customer replies, follow-ups). Restricted permissions; sensitive actions (payment release, GW assignment) gated to admin.

roles.label: Ghostwriter (GW)
roles.description: External freelance academic writer. Sees only their own assignments, the public job board, their payments, and the document templates library.

roles.label: Customer (Student)
roles.description: Buyer. Submits inquiry via public form, receives offer, pays, communicates with assigned GW (always with efactory1 in CC), receives interim and final work via the platform.

transitions.trigger: Customer submits public form OR admin manually creates
Customer accepts offer (Sevdesk invoice + Stripe link)
Stripe webhook payment_intent.succeeded OR admin Mark-as-paid (SEPA). Both call confirmPayment()
Berat lists job for GW pool (skipped if Berat self-assigns)
GW submits claim form with all 6 checkboxes
Berat approves; both GW and customer receive simultaneous emails
GW uploads interim. Auto-forwarded to customer.
QA approves; platform forwards to customer with 'quality check passed' message
Customer satisfied + all installments paid + revisions complete
Friday batch — Berat clicks Release Payment

edge_cases_and_micro_interactions: Customer multi-orders: customers with >1 active order show a small badge in the customers list and a 'related orders' panel on each order detail
'folgt' (TBD) paper title: orders can be saved without a title; UI shows 'folgt — awaiting customer' placeholder
Coaching orders show different micro-copy (advisory work, not ghostwriting)
Self-assigned orders never appear on the GW job board — admin sees a banner 'Self-assigned: this job is hidden from the board'
Shadow-banned GWs see the board normally if they visit, but receive no email alerts — admin sees a small ghost icon next to their name
Financial-question auto-redirect: if a customer types 'price', 'cost', 'pay', 'invoice' in chat to GW, the message is held and an auto-reply suggests contacting kundenservice@efactory1.de
Auto-CC enforcement: GW chat composer always shows efactory1 in CC chip (non-removable)
Pipedrive subscriber limit warning banner persists across admin pages until cleaned up
Friday countdown: a small badge in the topbar shows 'Friday batch in 2 days · 12 releasable'
When QA approves work: customer email auto-includes 'Your work has passed our quality check' line
When QA flags AI: GW account shadow-banned automatically with reason 'AI use suspected on Order #X' — admin must manually reverse
Plagiarism / AI score color rules: <15% green, 15–30% amber, >30% red
Empty states everywhere are illustrated with a one-line tip pointing to the next action

automation_assumptions.deadline_alerts: Cron runs daily at 09:00 — sends D-2 and D-1 alerts to GW + admin
